name: Kumano (Mie, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kumano city emblem in navy, light blue and green: a navy and light blue stylised wave above a green stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Kumano, a city in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 20 December 2005; the emblem dates from 16 December 2005.
